briefdescription.para: Incompressible Two Phase Flow Equation.

detaileddescription.para: first-order scheme for two phase flow ( linearazed form ): as in reference documentation
Computes all the terms necessary to solve in the saturation equation.
The gravitational segregation of the phases is taken care via the second term in:
dfds vt - d lambda_overbar / ds k (rho1 - rho2) g
This requires the analytically found derivative of the lambda overbar function.

sect1.title: Implementation
sect1.para: All flow properties are computed at the element barycenter.
Capillary spreading is modelled with the FEM, so it is not included here.
